statement: CoSec-Space-Id and CoSec-Device-Id are read from headers only, never from the query string. When the values of one of them differ, the request cannot be read unambiguously and is answered 400. A blank value beside a non-blank one differs too; only values that are all blank read as not sent, and blank is ASCII whitespace only, so a value of Unicode spaces is a value.
guards: spring-boot:WebAdapterParityTest#the three adapters answer byte for byte alike
runtime:ClientContractTest#the headers a client sends and reads are the contract's
